aiAlerts.title: Diesel consumption anomaly — Assam Asset
aiAlerts.detail: June diesel draw is 38% above the 3-month rolling mean while production fell 4%. Likely genset run-hours during grid outage on 12–15 June.

aiAlerts.title: Flare gas outside control band — Hazira
aiAlerts.detail: July flare volume trending 12% above the post-FGRU baseline. Recommend checking LPG Train B relief events.

aiAlerts.title: Missing steam meter reading — KG Basin
aiAlerts.detail: No steam consumption entry for July. Scope 2 emissions for the period will be understated by an estimated 1,180 tCO₂e.

aiAlerts.title: Emission factor version drift
aiAlerts.detail: 3 historical calculations still reference CEA Baseline v18. Recalculation recommended before ESG disclosure freeze.

initiatives.dependencies: Turnaround window TA-2026-Q3; O2 trim analyser procurement
initiatives.notes: Excess air control retrofit across 3 boilers; stack O2 target 2.4%.

initiatives.dependencies: OGI camera crew availability; platform POB limits
initiatives.notes: Quarterly OGI survey across 4,800 components; repair SLA 30 days.

initiatives.name: Diesel-to-Gas Switching — Lakwa Gathering Station
initiatives.dependencies: Gas allocation approval; dual-fuel kit delivery delayed 6 weeks
initiatives.notes: Converting 6 diesel gensets to dual-fuel operation on associated gas.

initiatives.name: 3.4 MWp Solar Installation — Cluster-2 Terminal
